name: nemotron_prompt_ab_v1
description: Five fixed-answer prompts for an exploratory prompt A/B benchmark.

cases.input: Compute 17 times 24. Return the numeric answer only.
There are 5 boxes with 6 notebooks each. If 7 notebooks are sold, how many remain? Return the numeric answer only.
Continue the sequence: 2, 4, 8, 16. Return the next number only.
How many days are there in 3 full weeks? Return the number only.
What is the difference between 100 and 63? Return the number only.
